name: arcosian
description: A principal game developer and full studio for Claude Code: a deep game-dev codex (design theory, mechanics, genres, case studies, psychology, economy, analytics, art, audio, tech, live-ops, release), a shared game ontology with schemas, 24 specialist agents, multi-agent workflows, simulators and solvers, an asset and audio gateway with budgets and provenance, Godot and Unity mobile templates, and hooks that enforce a five-gate definition of done.

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Image generation (Nano Banana family), Lyria music and Gemini TTS through the studio-gateway server. Leave empty to use placeholders.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: GPT Image models for hero art, key art and store screenshots.

recraft_api_key.title: Recraft API key
recraft_api_key.description: Vector icons and UI, background removal and vectorization.

fal_key.title: fal.ai key
fal_key.description: Hosted open-weight image models, LoRA training and upscaling.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Music, sound effects, voice design and dialogue.

stability_api_key.title: Stability AI API key
stability_api_key.description: Stable Audio for ambiences and textured sound design (optional).

asset_budget_usd.title: Default asset budget (USD)
asset_budget_usd.description: Default per-project spending cap for paid generation calls. A project's .gamestudio/config.json overrides it.
